source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. All components are easy to plug and unplug.
2. Check if device still be detect without error after plug cycle

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: All components should be seated properly

original_test_intent: Verify the physical seating and serviceability of the selected power-related component or connection and confirm that the expected device remains detectable without a new error after the single approved plug cycle. Despite the item title, the source defines no voltage tolerance, load profile, observation interval, loop count, or electrical-stability threshold.
original_method: A qualified engineer identifies the exact power assembly, safely isolates it as required, checks insertion/removal and seating, performs the one source-directed plug cycle, restores it, and records photographs and device/error evidence. The agent may prepare and collect approved read-only evidence but cannot perform or certify the physical operation.
manual_activity: The engineer locates and identifies the applicable power assembly, confirms isolation/discharge and service authorization, evaluates contacts, keying, retention and seating, performs the authorized disconnect/reconnect, and observes any physical abnormality. Remote telemetry cannot establish insertion quality, contact condition or safe manipulation.
required_inputs: Exact power component, cable or connector identity and location
Source-to-load or PSU-domain map for the affected assembly
Approved isolation, discharge and reconnection procedure
Expected device identity and approved post-cycle detection method
Project-defined physical seating and evidence checklist
Qualified operator and one-user approval for the unchanged plan
safety_requirements: Do not unplug or reconnect the assembly while energized unless the exact interface and operation are explicitly approved for energized service.

Verify the correct power domain, connector orientation, keying and discharge state before contact; never substitute a BMC power-off, software reboot or unrelated PDU action for the required physical cycle.
Stop on heat, arcing, odor, damaged insulation or contacts, abnormal resistance, forced insertion, unexpected shutdown, abnormal PSU status, missing device or loss of BMC/host access.
Preserve existing dmesg, syslog and SEL records; use a timestamped baseline and delta instead of clearing evidence.
Do not repeat the plug cycle, power-cycle, reboot or apply stress automatically after an anomaly.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the approved component, power-domain and expected-device checklist.
Collect read-only pre-action BMC/PSU, host reachability, device enumeration and event evidence with timestamps.
After the engineer confirms safe physical completion and restoration, collect the corresponding post-action evidence and raw log delta.
Compare expected and actual observations and flag discrepancies without issuing the formal test verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact assembly, isolation method and single physical plug-cycle plan.
Perform and document the physical inspection, disconnect/reconnect and final seating.
Authorize restoration and interpret any electrical or mechanical abnormality.
Apply the project criterion and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The not-runnable marker correctly rejects remote substitution for the physical core. Its generic mention of bent pins and routing is only relevant when observed on the selected power assembly; it is not a separate source requirement.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only project-approved read-only BMC/PSU, device-enumeration and event collectors mapped to the selected power domain. No generic command proves contact seating or electrical stability, and no control command is authorized by this review.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Attended Time 10 and Machine Time 0 remain unchanged. The source specifies one plug cycle and supplies no voltage, load, duration, loop, tool, command or retry parameter.

modernized_recommendation.status: PHYSICAL POWER-ASSEMBLY CHECK WITH MAPPED TELEMETRY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Pair a component-specific isolation and seating checklist with before/after photographs and mapped read-only PSU, device and event evidence. If a project intends electrical stability testing, define it as an approved override with explicit rails, load, sampling interval, limits and duration rather than treating the title as sufficient authority.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected chassis, power architecture, connector and attached device.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/assembly revision, applicable service procedure, BMC/firmware and evidence-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable platform power-assembly and service documentation; no universal electrical threshold or hot-service capability is asserted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the physical target and post-cycle evidence correlation explicit without converting the source into an unstated electrical soak test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The master case remains a one-cycle physical seating/detection check. A project-defined electrical stability overlay adds measurable coverage and must be reported separately.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Assembly identity, power-domain map, isolation procedure, expected device/status and physical criterion; electrical limits only if an override adds that scope.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Normal telemetry after restoration cannot prove contact integrity under all loads or long-duration electrical stability.

project_override_considerations: A project may add a bounded load, rail-monitoring interval or repetition count after engineering approval. Record that plan and its completed coverage separately; do not claim an unspecified electrical-stability test or the original physical action from software evidence alone.
expected_evidence: Power-assembly identity, location and affected source/load mapping
Approval plus isolation/discharge and restoration record
Timestamped operator checklist and photographs of contacts, keying, seating and retention
Raw pre/post BMC/PSU status, host reachability, expected-device enumeration and event delta
Any safety stop or coverage exception and the separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criterion consistently define physical seating plus post-cycle detection. The broad Power Stability title is underspecified for electrical-stability testing, but it does not contradict the executable source method.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical test intent is clear. Missing assembly identity, isolation details and expected evidence are execution-readiness inputs, not a permanent review block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keep NO/manual-only but constrain the case to the actual source-defined physical cycle and explicitly map post-cycle evidence to the affected power domain.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree that no voltage threshold or duration may be invented and that log history must be preserved; add explicit separation between the master physical case and any project electrical-stability overlay.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates manual physical acceptance, tool-observable restoration, engineer verdict and optional project stability coverage without treating missing project values as BLOCKED.

review_improvement: This review resolves the misleading title without rewriting the source: Power Stability here is a physical seating and single plug-cycle case. It prevents an agent from inventing an electrical soak or substituting remote power control while still defining useful mapped evidence collection.
independent_technical_reasoning: The acceptance depends on manipulating and inspecting a power-related assembly, so the complete case is MANUAL ONLY. The device-detection and log portions are automatable support, not the core acceptance. Because the source provides neither measurable electrical limits nor observation time, calling a voltage or load result would exceed source authority. Readiness inputs and an engineer-owned verdict stay separate from automation classification and execution status.

Do not reconnect again, reboot, power-cycle, reset or apply load without a newly approved engineering response.
